item.witch_atelier.silverwood_seed.descr: A silverwood seed. It seems alive...
Magic requires a pen and ink. Draw glyphs in the central 7x7 area. Important: once the drawing is complete, close the outer circle to activate it.
screen.witch_atelier.magic_guide.fire.de: Beam: sets enemies on fire. Aura: grants fire resistance. On a block: melts sand into glass.
screen.witch_atelier.magic_guide.light.d: Beam: blinds the target. Aura: grants night vision. On a block: creates a permanent light source.
screen.witch_atelier.magic_guide.water.d: Extinguishes fire. Aura: grants Dolphin's Grace. On a block: makes the surface slippery.
screen.witch_atelier.magic_guide.wind.de: Knocks targets back. Aura: grants Slow Falling. On a block: pushes upward like a piston.
screen.witch_atelier.magic_guide.earth.d: Beam: inflicts Weakness. Aura: grants Resistance. On a block: adds gravity.
screen.witch_atelier.magic_guide.crystal: Beam: amethyst. Aura: grants Luck. Without direction glyphs: releases a burst of energy.
screen.witch_atelier.magic_guide.ice.des: Slows targets. Draw the Water and Wind glyphs together inside the central 7x7 area.
screen.witch_atelier.magic_guide.vectors: T pointing outward: projectile. T pointing inward: aura. The stem length determines the spell's power.
screen.witch_atelier.magic_guide.vortice: A diagonal line at the edge of the circle. Changes the spell shape to concentration or dispersion.
screen.witch_atelier.magic_guide.trigger: A hollow cross at the edge. On a block: creates a mine. On yourself: creates a counterattack shield.
